exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "for, in order to".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! のために (no tame ni) matches "for, in order to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is のために (no tame ni).
exercises.explanation: Expresses purpose, reason, or benefit for an action or someone.
